tax.text: He touts tax cuts he helped pass in the 2025 budget, including write-offs on tips and overtime income.
tax.quote: When tens of millions of tipped and overtime workers go to file their taxes in 2026, they will be able to write off up to $25,000 of income from tips and overtime.

debt.text: He says he refused to support any budget that would cut Social Security benefits and voted to keep funding Medicare without cuts.
debt.quote: refused to support any budget that reduced Social Security benefits

housing.text: He says he helped pass an expansion of the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit to build more affordable housing.
housing.quote: This year, I helped to pass an expansion of the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC).

schools.text: His campaign pledged to expand school choice, and he sponsored school voucher legislation as a state lawmaker.
schools.quote: empower parents with expanded school choice

immigration.text: He supported budget measures to bar immigrants in the country illegally from taxpayer-funded benefits and has made border enforcement a priority.
immigration.quote: Prevents illegal immigrants from accessing taxpayer-funded benefits

guns.text: His campaign touted a consistent record of protecting Second Amendment rights and an NRA endorsement.
guns.quote: consistent voting record of protecting 2nd Amendment rights of law-abiding gun owners

abortion.text: His campaign touted a pro-life record and pledged to oppose efforts to expand legal abortion.
abortion.quote: fight back against the culture of celebrating abortion and those that want to legalize it up until the moment of birth

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: His campaign says he opposes transgender women competing in women's sports.
gender.quote: opposing men in women's sports, and standing up to radical policies

energy.text: He wants to expand American energy production to lower utility rates.
energy.quote: unleash American energy to reduce utility rates, and better control government spending
